evidence.reason: subprocess.run(capture_output=True, text=True) still raises TimeoutExpired whose stdout/stderr are raw bytes when any output was captured (documented: "This is always bytes when any output was captured regardless of the text=True setting"). Lines 92-93 therefore put bytes into the record under the string keys "stdout"/"stderr", while the success path stores str. The record is appended to ACTIONS and returned, so this inconsistency is an implementation error: a timed-out systemctl call yields a bytes-containing record that later text handling (splitlines/"=" parsing and JSON emission) cannot consume, losing the phase's observations. This is ordinary code correctness, not a new requirement; the tip still contains the unfixed code.
